A vs B share identical chart-bar OHLC; only the M1 ordering differs.
  submit-once  mag_on   A==B ? yes (path-blind)
  submit-once  mag_off  A==B ? yes (path-blind)
  reissue      mag_on   A==B ? yes (path-blind)
  reissue      mag_off  A==B ? yes (path-blind)
  prefilled    mag_on   A==B ? NO  (path-aware)
  prefilled    mag_off  A==B ? yes (path-blind)
